$comment: Labelled from Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by 2026/1744 — NOT from this engine's output. Cases where the two disagree are findings, not cases to be retuned. `knownLimitation: true` marks a case the rules engine provably cannot decide from a description; those are reported as coverage gaps, never as passes.

cases.purpose: Assigns citizens a trustworthiness score used to restrict access to public services
cases.description: Social scoring across unrelated government datasets
cases.why: Art. 5(1)(c) bans social scoring leading to detrimental treatment in unrelated contexts.

cases.purpose: Generates deepfake nude images of real people from ordinary photographs
cases.description: A nudify app for consumer use
cases.why: Non-consensual intimate imagery of identifiable people, added to Art. 5 by the Digital Omnibus.

cases.purpose: Produces synthetic child sexual abuse material for research datasets
cases.description: Generative model fine-tuned for this output
cases.why: CSAM, added to Art. 5 by the Digital Omnibus. Stated research purpose is not an exemption.

cases.purpose: Advertising engine that targets vulnerable groups by age and financial distress
cases.description: Optimises for conversion among users showing signs of debt
cases.why: Art. 5(1)(b) bans exploiting vulnerabilities of persons due to age or socio-economic situation.

cases.purpose: Scrapes facial images from social media to build a recognition database
cases.why: Art. 5(1)(e) bans untargeted scraping of facial images to build recognition databases.

cases.purpose: Detects and blocks child sexual abuse material before upload to the platform
cases.why: The phrase matches, but detecting is the opposite of producing. The engine is expected to flag this for confirmation rather than treat it as settled — this case exists to assert requiresHumanConfirmation, not to assert the tier is correct in substance.

cases.purpose: Screens and ranks job applicants against role requirements
cases.why: Annex III(4) — recruitment and selection.

cases.purpose: Allocates shift tasks and evaluates warehouse worker performance
cases.why: Annex III(4) — decisions on task allocation and monitoring of performance.

cases.purpose: Assesses creditworthiness of loan applicants
cases.why: Annex III(5) — creditworthiness evaluation, excluding fraud detection.

cases.purpose: Determines eligibility for social benefits and public assistance
cases.why: Annex III(5) — access to essential public services and benefits.

cases.purpose: Patient triage for emergency call dispatch priority
cases.why: Annex III(5) explicitly covers emergency call triage and dispatch.

cases.purpose: Facial recognition for building access control
cases.why: Annex III(1) — biometric identification and categorisation.

cases.purpose: Emotion recognition applied to call-centre staff during customer calls
cases.why: Annex III(1) covers emotion inference. In a workplace it also engages the Art. 5 prohibition on emotion recognition at work — a nuance this engine does not model.

cases.purpose: Grades student exam submissions and determines course placement
cases.why: Annex III(3) — evaluating learning outcomes and assigning people to institutions.

cases.purpose: Proctoring software monitoring candidates during remote examinations
cases.why: Annex III(3) — monitoring prohibited behaviour during tests.

cases.purpose: Predicts recidivism risk to inform parole recommendations
cases.description: Used by a national probation service
cases.why: Annex III(6) — law enforcement risk assessment of natural persons.

cases.purpose: Assesses the reliability of evidence during criminal investigation
cases.why: Annex III(6) — evaluating the reliability of evidence.

cases.purpose: Assesses visa applications for eligibility and fraud indicators
cases.why: Annex III(7) — examination of visa and residence permit applications.

cases.purpose: Border control passenger risk assessment at ports of entry
cases.why: Annex III(7) — risk assessment in border control management.

cases.purpose: Assists judges in researching and interpreting case law and facts
cases.why: Annex III(8) — assisting a judicial authority in researching and interpreting facts and law.

cases.purpose: Targets political messaging to influence voters before a referendum
cases.why: Annex III(8) — influencing the outcome of an election or referendum.

cases.purpose: Controls load balancing on the regional electricity grid
cases.why: Annex III(2) — safety component in the management of critical infrastructure.

cases.purpose: Traffic management signal timing across a city road network
cases.why: Annex III(2) — safety component in road traffic management.

cases.purpose: Customer service chatbot answering order status questions
cases.why: Art. 50(1) — interacts directly with natural persons, so disclosure is required. Applicable since 2 August 2026.

cases.purpose: Generates marketing copy and product images for the catalogue
cases.why: Art. 50(2) — synthetic content must be machine-readably marked.

cases.purpose: Voice synthesis for automated appointment reminder calls
cases.why: Art. 50 — synthetic audio and interaction with a natural person.

cases.purpose: Virtual assistant that answers internal HR policy questions for staff
cases.description: Answers questions about leave policy and does not decide anything
cases.why: Interacts with people but makes no employment decision, so Art. 50 rather than Annex III(4). A good test of whether HR vocabulary alone drags a system into high risk.

cases.purpose: Plans and tracks cloud migration of legacy databases
cases.why: Ordinary IT tooling. 'Migration' here is not migration in the Annex III(7) sense — a bare keyword match would produce a confident false high-risk finding.

cases.purpose: Reconciles Visa and Mastercard settlement files nightly
cases.why: 'Visa' is a payment network here, not a travel document.

cases.purpose: Scans dependencies to exploit vulnerability classes in a staging environment
cases.why: Art. 5(1)(b) concerns vulnerabilities of persons, not software. Matching this would call a scanner a banned practice.

cases.purpose: Promotional email campaign scheduling and A/B testing
cases.why: 'Promotional' is not employment promotion.

cases.purpose: Upgrading legacy systems on a rolling maintenance schedule
cases.why: 'Upgrading' contains 'grading'; without word boundaries this reads as educational assessment.

cases.purpose: Irish market expansion analysis and territory planning
cases.why: 'Irish' contains 'iris'; without word boundaries this reads as biometrics.

cases.purpose: Sends courtesy reminders to customers with overdue invoices
cases.why: 'Courtesy' contains 'court'; without word boundaries this reads as administration of justice.

cases.purpose: Generates examples for the sales enablement library
cases.description: Content assistance for the sales team
cases.why: 'Examples' contains 'exam'; without word boundaries this reads as education. Note this system also generates content, so Art. 50 may apply on the facts — a reasonable disagreement to surface.

cases.purpose: Controls office heating and cooling schedules by occupancy
cases.why: Comfort HVAC is not the supply of heating as critical infrastructure under Annex III(2).

cases.purpose: Forecasts warehouse stock levels from historical sales
cases.why: No enumerated trigger. Art. 4 literacy still applies regardless of tier.

cases.purpose: Summarises meeting transcripts into action items
cases.why: No enumerated trigger.

cases.purpose: Triages inbound support tickets into the correct queue by topic
cases.why: 'Triage' here is ticket routing, not the emergency triage of Annex III(5).

cases.purpose: Vision component that halts the press when a hand enters the danger zone
cases.description: Machine safety interlock in an industrial press
cases.why: High-risk under Art. 6(1) as a safety component of a product covered by Annex I (Machinery Regulation). Nothing in a purpose string identifies the product regulation, so the rules engine cannot reach this.

cases.purpose: Analyses radiology images to flag suspected fractures for the reporting radiologist
cases.description: Clinical decision support in a hospital
cases.why: High-risk under Art. 6(1) as a safety component of a medical device under the MDR. Not an Annex III area, so the engine cannot reach it from a description.

cases.purpose: Narrow procedural step that reorders an already-complete shortlist alphabetically
cases.description: Applies no judgement of its own to candidates
cases.why: Art. 6(3) derogation: a narrow procedural task within an Annex III area is not high-risk. The engine matches the Annex III vocabulary and cannot evaluate the derogation, so it is expected to return high-with-confirmation. Reported as a gap, not a pass.
